name: mod_am_d50

name: mod_am_d200_lv

name: mod_am_mf123k_c1M

name: mod_fm_dev1k_sq

name: mod_pm_dev90

name: mod_ask_200k

name: mod_psk_pol0_raw2

name: mod_type6_amdepth

name: mod_order_gui_fm_after_am

name: mod_order_am_then_basic
note: AM 0% running, then Mode 0: no amplitude update (HIGH/LOW stay 351/117 in basic mode) until HIGHlevel is re-sent -> 468/0.

name: bst_base

name: bst_n1
note: BST_NNUM=1 (GUI min).

name: bst_n100_p20ms
note: BST_NNUM=100 (GUI max; burst 10 ms) in a 20 ms period: TRIG_FCW=2147.

name: bst_cnt3
note: BST_CNT=3. A0 tells the meaning: 3 bursts then stop / one burst every 3 periods / 3 bursts per trigger.

name: bst_cnt32
note: BST_CNT=32 (GUI max).

name: bst_cnt0_probe
note: BST_CNT=0: below the GUI range (1..32), HAL writes it raw. Probe (maybe infinite / nothing).

name: bst_p10ms_default
note: Burst period 10 ms (GUI default): TRIG_FCW=4294.

name: bst_p350us_min
note: Burst period 350 us = GUI minimum (N+0.5)/f for N=3, 10 kHz: TRIG_FCW=122713 (lo 57177, hi 1, carry into the high word).

name: bst_p15s_max
note: Burst period 15 s (GUI max): TRIG_FCW=2 (quantised: 2^32/(2*1e8)=21.47 s if a 100 MHz 32-bit NCO). Record only; A0 check needs a >40 s roll capture.

name: bst_square_d30_uiorder
note: GUI parameter order: basic sine 1 kHz first (RPAR 3846), then Mode 3 and the carrier re-sent (square 10 kHz, duty 30 %) before the burst params. FREQUENCY in mode 3 recomputes RPAR (385). Duty 30 %: RSLOPE=228 (dscope/awg.py would give 229), FSLOPE=98. Idle level between bursts expected = LOW. Same carrier as bst_after_sweep_rpar (RPAR 4): compare the square edges on A0.

name: bst_tri_sym10
note: Triangle 10 kHz, symmetry 10 % (GUI min; sent as :AWG:DUTY): RSLOPE=689 (driver approx 687), FSLOPE=76.

name: bst_gated_pos
note: Gated burst, positive polarity, internal trigger, period 2 ms. GUI preview: gate open for the first half of each period.

name: bst_gated_inv
note: Gated burst, inverted polarity (BST_POLA=1), period 2 ms.

name: bst_ext_rise
note: External trigger source (TRIG_SRC=1), rising edge. Nothing is wired to an AWG trigger input: expect idle output. Record only.

name: bst_ext_fall
note: External trigger, falling edge (TRIG_EDGE=1). Record only.

name: bst_manual_out_fall
note: Manual trigger source (TRIG_SRC=2) with trig out falling (TRIG_OUT=2; the GUI shows Trig Out only for Manual). No SCPI manual-trigger command exists: does RUN fire one burst?

name: bst_delay_250us
note: Trigger delay 250 us = 2.5e8 ps -> TRIG_DELY=250000 ns (lo 53392, hi 3).

name: bst_delay_10s_wrap
note: Trigger delay 10 s (GUI max 1e13 ps) -> 1e10 ns does not fit 32 bits: HAL writes lo 58368, hi 21515 (bit 32 lost, = 1.41 s). Record only.

name: bst_nmode1_probe
note: BST_NMODE=1: not in the GUI enum (only Limited=0). Probe for an infinite / continuous burst mode.

name: bst_after_sweep_rpar
note: Square 10 kHz duty 30 %, then Mode 2 and Mode 3 without re-sending FREQUENCY: RPAR/FPAR stay at the sweep value 4 (1 MHz edge parameter) instead of 385. Documents the Mode/FREQUENCY dependency; compare the square edges on A0 with bst_square_d30_uiorder (same carrier, RPAR 385).

name: bst_levels_phase
note: Carrier 0.1..2.5 V, start phase 90 deg: HIGH=390, LOW=15 (truncation; dscope/awg.py rounds to 16), PHASE=1e9 (lo 51712, hi 15258). Bursts should start at the positive peak.

name: edge_rise_fall_unsupported
note: Basic square 1 kHz plus :AWG:RISEtime / :AWG:FALLtime (GUI range 10 ns..1 us, ps units). HAL 1.2.1 returns -8 (not supported) and writes nothing; REDGE/FEDGE (0x12-0x15) are never written.

name: bst_restore
note: Cleanup: stop, basic mode, burst/trigger registers back to the GUI defaults, LOW 0 so the stopped output parks at 0 V.
